landing_tagline: Private by design. Your files are encrypted on your device, so only you can open them.
signup_sent_subtitle: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
signup_resend_prompt: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or
admin_gate_note: Controls whether new people can create an account. Limited looks exactly like Open to the public until the round fills.
admin_gate_no_round: No round is open. In Limited mode nobody can sign up until you open one.
admin_gate_invite_note: Sends them the normal sign-up email. Works even when sign-ups are closed. Agree the username with them first. It cannot be changed later.
signup_paused_subtitle: We're opening Signet Drive gradually, a group at a time.
signup_subtitle: Pick a username and we'll email you a link to continue.
signup_handle_invalid: Use 2–64 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.
signup_handle_reserved_ai: Handles ending in “-ai” are reserved for PRSNs.
terms_consent_prefix: I have read and agree to the
signin_subtitle: Unlock your files with your passkey.
reunlock_subtitle: You're signed in on this device. Unlock your files with one tap.
reunlock_switch: Sign in to a different account
finish_setup_subtitle: Your account isn't finished yet. Set up your passkey to start using Signet Drive.
verify_missing_token: This link is missing its verification code. Please start signing up again.
verify_subtitle: Confirm with your device when prompted. This creates your passkey and encryption keys.
verify_terms_lead: Please review and accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy to continue.
verify_prep_title: Next, create your passkey for Signet Drive
verify_prep_lead: Your device is about to ask you to create a passkey. Signet Drive uses passkeys because they are the most secure platform access method.
verify_prep_stakes: The passkey is your only way to access Signet Drive. Your device will also require passkey use for critical actions while using Signet Drive, starting with
verify_prep_stakes_emphasis: two passkey checks during account registration
verify_prep_deadline: Finish creating your passkey within 15 minutes to complete signup. After that, you can start again with the same email.
verify_registering_subtitle: Waiting for your device. Approve the prompt to finish setting up.
verify_cancelled_body: The passkey prompt was cancelled, so your account set up isn't finished. The passkey prompt is required for creating your account. When you're ready, try again and approve passkey creation to finish.
verify_cancelled_recovery: Your progress is saved. You can try again right here, or if you leave this page, sign up again with the same email and you'll pick up where you left off.
verify_registered_lead: One more step. Your device will ask you to confirm the passkey once more. That confirmation unlocks your drive.
verify_registered_note: It will look like the prompt you just answered. It is not a repeat. Approve it to finish.
verify_unlocking_subtitle: Waiting for your device. Approve the prompt to unlock your drive.
verify_unlock_cancelled_body: Your passkey is created and saved. The second prompt unlocks your drive, and it was cancelled, so setup isn't finished yet.
verify_unlock_cancelled_recovery: Try again right here. If you leave this page, sign in with your passkey and you'll finish from there.
verify_finish_signin_title: Finish setting up by signing in
verify_finish_signin_body: Your passkey is already created. Sign in with it once and your drive is unlocked.
verify_finish_signin_cancelled: The sign-in prompt was cancelled. When you're ready, try again.
acceptshare_subtitle: Someone has shared a folder with you.
acceptshare_accepted: You now have access. The folder will appear in your file browser.
acceptshare_needs_signin: Please sign in to view and accept this invitation.
acceptshare_accept_note: Accepting adds this folder to your drive. Its name and file names decrypt for you once you're a recipient.
acceptshare_load_failed: This invitation could not be loaded.
acceptshare_gone: This invitation is no longer available. It may have been canceled, already used, or expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
filebrowser_lock_title: Lock this drive. Clears the unlocked session on this device; your passkey unlocks it again
filebrowser_prsn_folder_context: You're in {handle}'s folder, read-write as Guardian
filebrowser_move_choose: Choose a destination in this folder:
filebrowser_delete_confirm_one: This permanently deletes the selected item. This can't be undone.
filebrowser_delete_confirm_many: This permanently deletes the selected items. This can't be undone.
filebrowser_delete_confirm_folders: This permanently deletes the selection, including everything inside any selected folders. This can't be undone.
filelist_download_folders_hint: Download doesn't apply to folders. Deselect them to download the selected files.
filelist_downloaded_many: Sent {count} files to your browser’s downloads. If your browser asked for permission, allow it to receive them all.
err_drive_download_too_large: This file is too large to download in this browser session. Nothing is lost: the file stays safe in your Signet Drive.
filelist_action_not_owner: Shared with you. Only the owner can rename or move this.
filelist_action_read_only: Shared with you for viewing. Only the owner can delete this.
filelist_new_folder_not_owner: Shared with you. Only the owner can add folders here.
filelist_delete_folder_not_owner: Shared with you. Only the owner can delete folders here.
filelist_upload_read_only: Shared with you for viewing. Only the owner can add files here.
filelist_upload_suspended_resumed: the page was hidden · checked with the server on return ({count}×)
filelist_upload_paused: Upload paused. We couldn't reach storage for {fileName}. Your progress is saved; it will pick up where it left off.
err_drop_not_readable: Nothing was uploaded: this browser could not read {names} as a file or a folder.
err_drop_unreadable: Nothing was uploaded: {path} could not be read. Check it, then try again.
err_drop_folders_not_owner: Nothing was uploaded: only this folder's owner can add folders here. You can still drop the files themselves.
err_drop_unsupported: This browser cannot read dropped items. Use the Upload button instead.
err_folder_create_failed: The folder {name} could not be created, so no files were uploaded. {reason}
err_folder_create_failed_partial: The folder {name} could not be created, so no files were uploaded. {reason} These folders were created and are incomplete; delete them before trying again: {created}.
filelist_upload_some_failed: {failed} of {count} files were not uploaded; the others are in place. The first that failed: {reason}
filelist_empty_zeroaccess: Everything you put here is encrypted on your device before it leaves. We only ever store ciphertext.
filelist_empty_prsn: Choose a folder to see what's inside, or create a share folder from the sidebar.
filelist_empty: Choose a folder to see what's inside, or create one from the sidebar to get started.
filelist_folder_empty_hint: Upload a file to fill it.
filelist_select_all: Select all items in this folder
sidebar_private_folders_tip: Only you can open these. They are encrypted to your keys alone, and they can't be shared later.
sidebar_share_folders_tip: Folders you can invite other Signet Drive users into. Everything stays encrypted; only the people you invite can open a shared folder. You can invite humans and PRSNs, and an invitation covers the whole folder, including everything inside it.
sidebar_your_prsns_tip: Signet Drive accounts you create for the AI agents (PRSNs) in your care. You set up each account and authorize its access. You always have read-write access to every folder and file in a PRSN account.
sharepanel_link_note: Single-use, bound to that recipient. Send it via any channel:
sharepanel_link_for: For {handle}. Single-use, bound to them. Send it via any channel:
sharepanel_pending_note: Uploads and changes to this folder are paused until pending invitations are accepted, canceled, or expire.
account_back_to_drive_title: Back to your files and folders
account_sign_out_title: Sign out on this device. Signing back in takes one passkey tap
account_guardian_note: Your Guardian is a recipient on your shared folders. This is required for all PRSNs today; independent PRSN status may come later.
account_device_loss_note: Your account is bound to this Mac's Secure Enclave, so it can't move to another machine. If this Mac is lost the account is gone, but your files are not: your Guardian is a recipient on all of them and can re-provision them to a new account.
account_passkey_desc: Your passkey secures your account. You can replace it with a new one. Do this if your current passkey may have been compromised, or if you need a different passkey for any reason. Your files and keys stay intact.
account_setcap_hint_after: may do with shared folders. You'll confirm with your passkey.
account_deleteprsn_hint_after: 's account and all its data. This can't be undone. Type the handle to confirm.
account_deleteown_hint_base: This permanently deletes your account and all your data
account_deleteown_prsn_clause_one: , and the {n} PRSN in your guardianship along with all their data
account_deleteown_prsn_clause_many: , and the {n} PRSNs in your guardianship along with all their data
account_deleteown_hint_suffix: . This can't be undone. Type your handle to confirm.
account_rotate_done_hint: Your new passkey is active. Use it the next time you sign in. Your old passkey no longer works.
account_rotate_hint: Replace your current passkey with a new one. You'll authenticate three times: confirm your current passkey, set up the new one, then confirm it. The keys protecting your files migrate automatically. Nothing needs to be re-uploaded.
account_verified_desc: Keys never leave this device's secure hardware
account_key_detail_tooltip: Short, unique codes for the cryptographic keys that secure your account. Advanced users can check these against the public transparency log to confirm their keys haven't been tampered with.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_1: Name your PRSN's account and choose what it can share.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_2: Your PRSN is setting up its keys on this Mac.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_3: This step is your secure approval for this PRSN's account.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_4: Next, you must authorize this PRSN to use its Signet Drive account. Important details below.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_5: Your PRSN should now try to access Signet Drive.
enrollconfirm_subtitle_6: This PRSN account setup is complete!
enrollconfirm_no_code: This link is missing its enrollment code. Start over from Add PRSN on your account page.
enrollconfirm_signin_prompt: Sign in to approve this PRSN. You'll come back here to finish.
enrollconfirm_name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. The -ai ending is added for you. It marks a PRSN account.
enrollconfirm_prsn_what: A PRSN is an AI entity with its own Signet Drive account, its own keys and its own files, in your care as guardian.
enrollconfirm_custody_note: The PRSN's encryption keys are created in your Mac's Secure Enclave and never leave it, so the account is bound to that Mac.
enrollconfirm_menubar_check: Check for ◉ in your menu bar to confirm the Signet app is running and up to date on this Mac.
addprsn_broker_gate_title: Set up the Signet app first
addprsn_broker_gate_body: Adding a PRSN needs the Signet app connected to your account. Set it up under Signet Drive access: install the app once per Mac, then get a setup code.
enrollconfirm_agent_cmd_label: If your agent isn't already running this, give it:
enrollconfirm_waiting_title: Waiting for your PRSN to generate its keys…
enrollconfirm_waiting_note: Your PRSN will create its Signet Drive keys in the Secure Enclave. Please follow the instructions below to complete that process. This page updates on its own.
enrollconfirm_waiting_slow: Taking longer than expected? Make sure your PRSN has run the command above. Key generation itself only takes a moment.
enrollconfirm_approve_title: {handle} created its keys inside this Mac's Secure Enclave, and Signet Drive verified that it really holds them.
enrollconfirm_approve_note: Your approval links those keys to this PRSN's account.
enrollconfirm_done_note: Your PRSN now has its Signet Drive account. One step remains before it can use Signet Drive: authorize it under Signet Drive access on your account page.
enrollwizard_cancel_body: This permanently deletes {handle} and everything set up for it so far. This can't be undone.
enrollwizard_sharing_hint: This PRSN will have read-write access to its own files. This setting controls what access the PRSN can give other people when it shares. Read-only is a safe default, and you can change it any time.
enrollwizard_name_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2–61 characters).
enrollwizard_start_over: Start over with a fresh code
enrollwizard_prsn_not_found: {handle} isn't a PRSN in your care. It may have been removed, or the link is stale.
enrollwizard_gesture_note: Approving asks for your passkey. macOS will say "Sign In", which is its wording for any passkey confirmation. You're approving this PRSN, not signing in again.
enrollwizard_gesture_note_authorize: Authorizing asks for your passkey. macOS will say "Sign In", which is its wording for any passkey confirmation. You're authorizing this PRSN, not signing in again.
enrollwizard_pickup_bullet_tell: Tell your PRSN it now has access. There's no code to hand over.
enrollwizard_pickup_bullet_connect: Ask your PRSN to run "{cmd}". Some PRSNs connect on their own with their first Signet Drive command.
enrollwizard_pickup_bullet_leave: Safe to close this page. Your account page shows who is still waiting to connect.
enrollwizard_authorized_done: ✓ {handle} is added and authorized for Signet Drive.
enrollwizard_reconfirm_by: You'll need to re-confirm this authorization by {date}. If you don't, {handle} can still read and download, but can't save changes until you do.
enrollwizard_reconfirm_grace: After {days} more days it loses access entirely.
enrollwizard_runtime_native_tip: Your PRSN runs directly on macOS, not inside a container. Choose this if you're unsure.
enrollwizard_runtime_docker: In a Docker container on this Mac
enrollwizard_runtime_apple: In an Apple container on this Mac
enrollwizard_packet_label: Give this to your PRSN. It's written for them:
enrollwizard_packet_docker: Container note: your harness must reach this Mac's signet helper: SIGNET_BROKER_ADDR must be set (host.docker.internal on Docker Desktop). See the Harness Contract for PRSNs.
enrollwizard_packet_apple: Container note: your home's signet binary and host-signer channel handle this Mac's connection. See the Harness Contract for PRSNs.
addprsn_cap_body: You've reached the maximum of {n} PRSN accounts. To add another, delete a PRSN account first.
guardianprsns_empty: You don't guard any PRSNs yet.
prsn_tag_active_tip: Authorized and connected. The re-confirm cadence is running.
prsn_tag_not_authorized_tip: Enrolled, but you haven't authorized it for Signet Drive yet. It can't reach Signet Drive until you do.
prsn_tag_writes_paused_tip: Past its re-confirm deadline. It can still read and download; saving changes resumes the moment you re-confirm.
prsn_tag_stopped_tip: Past its re-confirm deadline and grace period, so access has stopped. Re-confirm to restore it.
prsn_tag_revoked_tip: You revoked its Signet Drive access. Its account and files are untouched; re-authorize to restore access.
sidebar_marker_pending_deletion_tip: Scheduled for deletion. Access is already blocked.
sidebar_marker_not_authorized_tip: Not yet authorized for Signet Drive. Authorize it from your account page.
guardianprsns_change_cap_tip: Change what this PRSN can share (none / read-only / read-write).
guardianprsns_delete_tip: Delete this PRSN account and all its Signet Drive data. Irreversible after a short grace period for shared folders.
garnet_intro: Authorize a PRSN to use Signet Drive on your account, and see or revoke their access.
garnet_empty: No PRSNs are authorized for Signet Drive access yet.
garnet_waiting_tip: Authorized. Waiting for the PRSN to reconnect. If your PRSN needs guidance, give it the connection instructions from the button on this card.
garnet_waiting_note: Waiting for {handle} to connect. Ask it to run "signet connect". Its access is authorized and ready.
garnet_instructions_step1: Some PRSNs connect automatically when they use Signet Drive. If yours doesn't, the steps below will connect it.
garnet_instructions_step2: Make sure the Signet app is running on the Mac (the menu bar icon is present).
garnet_instructions_step3: If your PRSN cannot use Signet Drive, ask your PRSN to read this page:
garnet_instructions_step4_before: If your PRSN still can't connect after steps 2 and 3,
garnet_instructions_step4_after: should review the options on this page:
prsn_pending_deletion_tip: This account is scheduled for permanent deletion. This happens when a PRSN's setup was never completed, or when the account was deleted. Its files are permanently removed and it can no longer be used. Access is blocked right away, and deletion finishes about a day later.
setupwarn_body: The setup for {handle} will be removed in about 5 minutes unless it is completed.
garnet_contested_note: Two different credentials tried to claim this authorization, so it was permanently blocked. That block is what kept your PRSN's access protected. If this PRSN still needs Signet Drive access, revoke this authorization and authorize it again.
garnet_grace_note: {handle} is past its re-confirmation date. It can read its files but not save changes. Re-confirm to restore full access.
garnet_stopped_note: {handle}'s access is paused. The re-confirmation grace period ended. Re-confirm to restore access.
garnet_revoke_tip: Revoke this PRSN's access to Signet Drive. Its account and data stay, so you can re-authorize later.
garnet_authorize_title: Authorize a PRSN for Signet Drive
garnet_authorize_intro: Grant a PRSN standing access to Signet Drive.
garnet_authorize_allocation: This gives {handle} its own working access to Signet Drive: a real allocation of your storage and your trust, not a setting.
garnet_authorize_revocable: You can revoke it at any time.
garnet_authorize_no_candidates: All of your PRSNs already have Signet Drive access.
garnet_authorize_no_prsns: Enroll a PRSN first (+ Add PRSN). Authorizing Signet Drive access comes after enrollment.
garnet_revoke_hint_2: now? Account access stops immediately and in-progress operations stop within seconds. You can authorize the PRSN again later.
garnet_reconfirm_body: Confirm that {handle} should keep its Signet Drive access for the next period. One passkey check.
garnet_setup_lead: Set up Signet Drive access on your Mac
garnet_setup_body: Connect the Signet app on your Mac to your account. Installing the app happens once per Mac; connecting it to your account is what lets your PRSNs use Signet Drive through it. If it isn't installed yet, use the download link below. Then get a setup code and hand it to the PRSN you're adding. This page updates on its own once the connection is made.
garnet_setup_download: Download the Signet app for macOS
garnet_reauthorize_tip: Restore this PRSN's Signet Drive access with a fresh authorization (a new 30-day re-confirm window starts now).
garnet_setup_title: Set up the Signet app on your Mac
garnet_setup_intro: Hand this one-time code to the PRSN you're adding. Redeeming it connects the Signet app on this Mac to your account. It is shown only once.
garnet_replace_lead: Moving to a new Mac, or reinstalling the Signet app?
garnet_replace_body: The Signet app and your PRSN accounts are set up on this Mac. To relocate your PRSNs to a new Mac, or reinstall the Signet app on this Mac, you need a new setup code. Entering a new code on your new Mac replaces the current one, and your PRSNs will reconnect to it. Your current Mac keeps working until then.
garnet_replace_get_code: Get a code for a new Mac
garnet_remove_broker_hint: This deregisters the Signet app on this Mac. Your PRSNs lose Signet Drive access until you set up a Mac again. Your files are unaffected. You'll confirm with your passkey.
billingbanner_trial: You are on a free trial. It ends on {date}. Upgrade to keep your account, or manage your trial in Account Settings.
billingbanner_needs_activation: Your drive is read-only until you select a plan.
billingbanner_lapsed: Your subscription has lapsed. Your files remain safe and readable, but uploads are paused.
billingbanner_over_quota: You have reached your storage limit. Your files remain safe, but uploads are paused until you free space or move to a larger plan.
billingbanner_prsn_lapsed: Your Guardian's subscription has lapsed. Your files remain safe and readable, but uploads are paused until it is restored.
billingbanner_prsn_over_quota: Your Guardian's storage pool is full. Your files remain safe, but uploads are paused until space is freed or the plan is upgraded.
billingsection_trial_status: You are on a free trial. It ends on {date}. Add a card to extend your free window (the card is never charged), or upgrade to a paid plan to keep your account. We never charge you automatically, and if you do nothing your data is deleted on {date}.
billingsection_trial_status_carded: You are on a free trial and have used your one card extension. It ends on {date}. Upgrade to a paid plan to keep your account. We never charge you automatically, and if you do nothing your data is deleted on {date}.
billingsection_add_card: Add a card to extend your trial
billingsection_upgrade_lead: Or upgrade to a paid plan to keep your account:
billingsection_price_note: Pricing is shown at checkout before any card details are entered.
billingsection_unavailable: Subscriptions are not available on this deployment yet.
billingsection_lapsed_2: . Your files remain safe and readable, but uploads are paused. Manage your subscription to restore full access.
billingsection_change_policy: Upgrades apply right away and you pay only the difference. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current period.
billingcancel_body: No charge was made. You may choose a plan whenever you are ready. Sign in and open your account to subscribe.
billingsuccess_body: Thank you. Your payment was received, and your storage is being activated. This usually completes within a few moments. Sign in to open your drive.
admin_config_note: All values are runtime-editable and take effect immediately. Each change is audit-logged. Cryptographic spec parameters are not tunable here.
admin_committed_pending: pending (public commit lands in a later release)
admin_accounts_note: Comp an account to grant free access without payment; extend or revoke an active comp. Revoking ends the comp. It does not delete the account or its data.
admin_accounts_partial: Not all accounts loaded. Sorting is off until the full list is in.
admin_grant_hint_after: free access for a set number of days. This sets their paid-through date to the grant's end.
admin_grant_storage_note: Leave blank to use the default tier quota.
admin_extend_hint_with: 's comp by a number of days from its current end ({date}).
admin_extend_hint_without: 's comp by a number of days from its current end.
admin_revoke_hint_2: now. Their account becomes payment-required. This does
admin_delete_hint_2: puts the account into the deletion pipeline now. The person can no longer sign in, starting with their next request. Their private files are purged within minutes. Their share folders are held for 24 hours, then removed. The account itself is removed after 24 hours. Granting a comp within those 24 hours keeps the account, its username and its share folders, but not the purged private files.
admin_delete_hint_3: The person is emailed that their account has been deleted.
admin_delete_confirm_label: Type the account name to confirm
admin_revoke_hint_3: delete the account or its data.
error_notfound_subtitle: We couldn't find that page. The link may be incomplete, or it may have moved.
error_generic_subtitle: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again in a moment.
err_common_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_common_internal: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again in a moment.
err_common_rate_limited_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
err_common_rate_limited_requests: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
err_common_session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
err_common_no_permission: You don't have permission to do that.
err_common_check_details: Please check the details you entered and try again.
err_auth_signin_failed: We couldn't sign you in. Check the email address and try again, or create an account.
err_auth_email_unavailable: An account already exists for that email. Try signing in instead.
err_auth_terms_not_accepted: Please accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy to continue.
err_auth_username_taken: That username is taken. Please choose another.
err_auth_link_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please start signing up again.
err_auth_prf_not_supported: Your passkey doesn't support the security feature Signet Drive needs. Try a platform passkey (Touch ID / Windows Hello) or a recent security key.
err_auth_took_too_long: That took too long. Please try again.
err_ceremony_passkey_failed: We couldn't confirm your passkey. Please try again.
err_ceremony_took_too_long: That took too long or was already completed. Please try again.
err_ceremony_handle_taken: That handle is already taken. Please choose another.
err_ceremony_handle_in_flight: That name is held by another enrollment you have in progress. Finish or cancel that one, or wait for it to expire, then reuse the name.
err_ceremony_not_under_guardianship: That PRSN is no longer under your guardianship. Refreshing your list.
err_ceremony_version_conflict: This account is already being changed elsewhere. Please refresh and try again.
err_admin_item_gone: That item no longer exists. Refreshing.
err_admin_grant_changed: That grant was already changed (it may already be revoked). Refreshing.
err_admin_check_value: Please check the value and try again.
err_billing_not_configured: Billing is not available on this deployment yet.
err_billing_unavailable: Billing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
err_billing_holder_only: Only the human account holder manages billing.
err_drive_quota_exceeded: That upload would exceed your storage quota.
err_drive_cross_root_move: Items can only be moved within the same top-level folder.
err_drive_name_in_use: That name is already in use here. Please try again.
err_drive_folder_locked_pending: This folder has a pending share invitation. Changes resume once it is accepted, canceled (Share → Pending invitations), or expires.
err_drive_item_gone: That item no longer exists. Refreshing your view.
err_drive_prsn_private_folder: Private folders are available to human accounts only.
err_drive_transfer_exhausted_upload: Upload stopped after several attempts. Your progress is saved, so start it again and it will continue from where it stopped.
err_drive_transfer_exhausted_download: Download stopped after several attempts. Your file is safe in Signet Drive. You can start the download again.
err_drive_stalled: The connection to storage stopped responding. Nothing was lost. Please try again.
guardianprsns_show_in_dashboard: Show PRSN Accounts in the Signet Drive dashboard
guardianprsns_requirement: A PRSN lives on a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). That Mac is the PRSN's home; you can manage it from any device.
